context.title: Rebellion at Kadesh
context.summary: The people refuse to enter Canaan and talk of returning to Egypt; Moses intercedes and God pardons them, but decrees that this generation will die in the wilderness over forty years, except Caleb and Joshua.
context.background: Moses' prayer quotes God's own words from Exodus 34:6–7 (vv. 17–19), appealing both to God's reputation among the nations and to his character. The next day the people try to invade without God and are defeated at Hormah (vv. 40–45).

customs.note: One year of wandering for each of the forty days the spies explored the land.

watchFor: 'The LORD is with us: fear them not' (v. 9).
Caleb 'had another spirit with him, and hath followed me fully' (v. 24).
The children they feared for are the ones who will enter (v. 31).

people.name: Israel
people.summary: One who follows on another’s heels; supplanter, (Gen. 25:26; 27:36; Hos. 12:2-4), the second born of the twin sons of Isaac by Rebekah. He was born probably at Lahai-roi, when his father was fifty-nine and Abraham one hundred and fifty-nine years old.

people.name: Moses
people.summary: Drawn (or Egypt. mesu, “son;” hence Rameses, royal son). On the invitation of Pharaoh (Gen. 45:17-25), Jacob and his sons went down into Egypt.

people.name: Aaron
people.summary: The eldest son of Amram and Jochebed, a daughter of Levi (Ex. 6:20). Some explain the name as meaning mountaineer, others mountain of strength, illuminator.

people.name: Joshua
people.summary: Jehovah is his help, or Jehovah the Saviour. The son of Nun, of the tribe of Ephraim, the successor of Moses as the leader of Israel.

people.name: Caleb
people.summary: The son of Jephunneh (Num. 13:6; 32:12; Josh. 14:6, 14). He was one of those whom Moses sent to search the land in the second year after the Exodus.

people.name: Nun
people.summary: Beyond the fact that he was the father of Joshua nothing more is known of him (Ex. 33:11).

people.name: Jephunneh
people.summary: The father of Caleb, who was Joshua’s companion in exploring Canaan (Num. 13:6), a Kenezite (Josh. 14:14).

places.name: Egypt
places.summary: The land of the Nile and the pyramids, the oldest kingdom of which we have any record, holds a place of great significance in Scripture.

places.name: Red sea
places.summary: The sea so called extends along the west coast of Arabia for about 1,400 miles, and separates Asia from Africa. It is connected with the Indian Ocean, of which it is an arm, by the Strait of Bab-el-Mandeb.

places.name: Hormah
places.summary: Banning; i.e., placing under a “ban,” or devoting to utter destruction.
